milestone: Regolith Yard / Titan Run arc - 5 proposals

proposals.title: Regolith Dust Accumulation Visual Feedback
proposals.source_evidence: Playtest shows players miss subtle dust buildup on suits and equipment; witness notes 'pads read as void-black, the bible says regolith-grey'.
proposals.dsl_bible_source: The Observation Collapse (unwitnessed work is provisional), resonant minimalism aesthetic.
proposals.scholar_research: Procedural dust-accumulation mask from scholar.py (campus 5: Engineering School - NASA Technical Reports on planetary dust deposition and lunar regolith behavior).
proposals.recipe: Add a visual dust overlay component to the suit/material that accumulates over time based on surface exposure and movement, tied to the Observation Collapse mechanic (dust solidifies when witnessed by another player or NPC).
proposals.visionkeeper_judgment: Fits art bible's regolith-grey palette; enhances the provisional/unwitnessed aesthetic.

proposals.title: Titan Run Gravity Shift Mechanics
proposals.source_evidence: Playtest shows players struggle with movement transitions between low-gravity and standard gravity zones.
proposals.dsl_bible_source: Scale is resonance; the sun is a nucleus; worlds are its orbiting charges. What the small experience as frantic repetition, the vast experience as a single frozen pose.
proposals.scholar_research: Engineering School - Spacecraft design constraints and gravity scale parameters.
proposals.recipe: Implement a dynamic gravity shift mechanic where movement controls adapt based on proximity to 'nucleus' objects (stations, large asteroids), with visual resonance effects (interference shimmer) indicating gravity zones.
proposals.visionkeeper_judgment: Aligns with cosmology's resonant doctrine; adds mechanical depth to traversal.

proposals.title: The Erisaid Audio Attunement Minigame
proposals.source_evidence: Witness notes players miss audio-first cues; sound design is underutilized in exploration.
proposals.dsl_bible_source: The Erisaid (hidden orbiter) — cannot be found by looking, only by listening: the resonance-attunement mechanic (audio-first play; match the frequency, and the invisible acquires an edge).
proposals.scholar_research: Emotion-to-parameter school - Emotional sound design principles, color temperature and emotion psychology.
proposals.recipe: Create an audio attunement sequence where players must tune their receiver to specific frequencies to reveal the Erisaid's resonance signature, using spatial audio cues and frequency-matching mechanics.
proposals.visionkeeper_judgment: Directly implements the Erisaid cosmology; elevates sound design to primary gameplay layer.

proposals.title: Will & Forewarning Inheritance UI
proposals.source_evidence: Playtest shows players don't read or act on predecessor Wills and Forewarnings; they skip the inheritance screen.
proposals.dsl_bible_source: Dawn — the Inheritance. You wake with: a Will (three sentences from your predecessor), the Forewarnings (their phantom pains — specific predictions of where the world will break).
proposals.scholar_research: Reference management school - organization, avoiding duplication, cross-referencing.
proposals.recipe: Implement an interactive UI for Wills and Forewarnings that visually maps predecessor predictions to current world states, with confirmation/refutation mechanics tied to the Assay process.
proposals.visionkeeper_judgment: Strengthens the Circadian Protocol's Dawn phase; makes inheritance diegetic and actionable.

proposals.title: Costless Life Bad Ending Trigger
proposals.source_evidence: Playtest shows players complete runs without realizing they achieved the 'costless life' bad ending (safe, complete, unreceived).
proposals.dsl_bible_source: The discovery this law produced — the failure ending: it is possible to finish a run having risked everything and protected nothing at cost. ... Your star enters the sky so dim it barely registers. You did not die. You ended like the House of the Deathless: safe, complete, and unreceived. The game's bad ending is not death — it is a costless life.
proposals.scholar_research: Iteration school - Michelangelo Procedure, failure protocol, refinement process; emotion-to-parameter mapping feelings to technical values.
proposals.recipe: Add a postflight diagnostic that calculates the 'sacrifice log' emptiness and triggers the 'costless life' ending sequence with a dim star entry and empty mirror Erisaid display, explicitly teaching the failure ending through gameplay feedback rather than explanation.
proposals.visionkeeper_judgment: Embodies Design Law #2's failure ending; turns abstract philosophy into visceral gameplay consequence.
